title: Conveyor Belt (condition variables)

links.title: C++ Core Guidelines CP.42: don't wait without a condition

hints: Members: a std::deque<int>, the capacity, a bool closed, one std::mutex, and two std::condition_variable: not_full and not_empty.
pop: std::unique_lock lock(m); not_empty.wait(lock, [&] { return !items.empty() || closed; }); then if items is empty (so it is closed) return std::nullopt.
push mirrors it: not_full.wait(lock, [&] { return items.size() < capacity || closed; }); if closed return false; push_back; then not_empty.notify_one().
After a successful pop call not_full.notify_one(): a producer may be waiting for that free slot.
close: set closed under the lock, then notify_all() on BOTH condition variables - every sleeper has to wake up and see it.
